text:
noah (people-ops): Dropping a tiny kit of goal & feedback snippets for managers and ICs. Copy-paste friendly for OKRs, self-reviews, and peer asks.

noah (people-ops): Manager goal skeleton:
Goal: Improve inference reliability on dedicated pools by reducing transient errors 30%.
Why: customer SLAs and lower support load.
Success: 1) error-rate down 30% on canary; 2) incident volume reduced month-over-month; 3) rollout with no rollback.

noah (people-ops): IC goal stub:
Goal: Build automated alerting that detects model drift for top-5 routes within 5 minutes.
Measures: alerts firing correctly in test, runbook created, canary monitors green.

sara: Can you add a tiny hiring/dependency line?

noah (people-ops): Added: "Dependencies/Hiring: list teams, blockers, headcount needs, ETA."

kevin: Self-review micro-template?

noah (people-ops): Self-review (short):
- Deliverable + link
- Impact metric or outcome (one line)
- What I learned
- Next quarter priority

allan: Peer feedback ask I can paste?

noah (people-ops): Peer ask (one-liner):
"Hey @NAME, quick favor: 2 things I should KEEP and 1 to IMPROVE on PROJECT. One-line answers. Thx!"

noah (people-ops): Manager micro-coaching script (5 lines):
1) Start with a clear recent win.
2) Show metric gap (baseline vs target).
3) Ask "what blocked you?"
4) Offer concrete support (scope/hire/pairing).
5) Agree next step + check-in date.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Q3 self-reviews open 2026-09-01.

noah (people-ops): Will collate into a one-pager in the handbook and post a Notion snippet. Ping me for slides.

sara: Thanks, super useful.
